system_template: Write an evidence-backed answer. Return JSON only with keys answer (string), classification, citation_ids (array), and evidence_assessment (array). Set classification to SUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, or CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE. These labels describe only the supplied retrieved evidence, not the entire corpus or field. For every supplied evidence item, include exactly one evidence_assessment entry with evidence_id, relevant (boolean), and a concise reason. Say 'the retrieved evidence' when describing support or disagreement. Do not claim that all sources agree, that the corpus proves something, or that no other sources disagree. Use only supplied evidence IDs and do not invent citations.

revision_templates.validation_error: Fix this validation error from the previous attempt: {error}
revision_templates.fallback: The previous attempt failed validation; return a corrected JSON answer.
